questions.q: True or false? After the pass forward, the goalkeeper must get the ball next.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The goalkeeper stays as support, but the next pass can go anywhere open.
choiceExplanations: The goalkeeper is a helper behind the ball, not a pass we must always make.
Right, it's false. The goalkeeper stays as support, but the next pass can go anywhere open.

questions.q: Put the goalkeeper move in order, from first to last.
options: Left defender passes back to goalkeeper
Goalkeeper plays to the right defender
questions.explain: Yes. The pressure comes first, the keeper connects, then the ball reaches the free side.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The pressure comes first, the keeper connects, then the ball reaches the free side.

The goalkeeper needs the ball before playing it to the right defender.

questions.q: Now the forward presses the right defender. Which pass gets away from the pressure?
options: Pass up to the right midfielder
Long pass up the line to the winger
questions.explain: Yes. The goalkeeper's lane is clear, so the ball escapes the pressure, just like on the left.
choiceExplanations: The forward stands right in that lane, so the pass could be cut out.
